messages:
li: noticed odd spikes in org-facing quota badges. customer reported quota exhausted warning for org:acme but our metrics show the tokens were consumed by org:beta around the same time. not a full data dump but wrong attribution.
jamie: steps to repro?
li: in prod can repro when we failover a routing node during a heavy burst. badge refresh pulls aggregation cache from routing-cache and shows the last-seen "ownerOrg" field.
li: quick inspect of the aggregator code shows the cache key is `apiKey:route` (no tenant/org). that means when node A serves beta and node B serves acme, the shared cache under the same apiKey conflates.
```
// aggregator cache key
const cacheKey = `${request.apiKey}:${route}`; // BUG: missing request.orgId
const bucket = cache.get(cacheKey);
```

nora: confirmed locally with a repro harness that flips route owner between two orgs. bucket.ownerOrg property is set by first writer and reused.
henry: is this the same shared in-memory cache we added for quota micro-optimizations last quarter?
li: yes. QuickPrefetch / AggregatorService shares an LRU per instance. we assumed apiKey uniquely maps to org but with service principals that map multiple orgs to same key this breaks.
ops-bot: alert: rollout quick_quota_cache_optim = true at 2026-03-20T23:45:00Z
jamie: mitigation options: 1) rollback feature flag quick_quota_cache_optim (frontend and aggregator flip), 2) add a guard on read to verify bucket.ownerOrg == request.orgId and drop on mismatch, 3) patch cache key to include orgId and deploy.
li: prefer guard + key fix. rollback will hurt latency. guard is cheap and fixes immediate mis-attribution.
henry: agree. I'll open a hotfix PR that does both: add orgId to key and a read-guard; add unit tests around service-principal mappings. include a small integration test that simulates failover and rapid switch.
nora: i'll coordinate rollback only if we see more customer impact. I'll also open a customer ticket and post a note to CS.
jamie: add a telemetry delta check: emit metric `quota.attribution_mismatch` when guard drops a cache entry. Maria from SRE can set an alert when it spikes.
li: PR needs to be fast. henry, please include migration note: existing cache entries will be ignored after key change; that's fine. also add a short lived sweep that invalidates `apiKey:route` keys that have ownerOrg != null to avoid stale bad hits.
henry: will do. PR: https://git.redwood/s/aggregator/fix/quota-key-org-1745993333 (includes repro harness and smoke scripts).
ops-bot: CI pipeline: hotfix build queued.
li: timeline?
henry: guard patch to prod in ~45m if CI green. key-change rollout in next deploy window.
jamie: will watch telemetry. nora, loop in CS with expected behavior and transient quota warnings for affected customers.
li: thanks. small postmortem after fix.
